meta.title: Memory Archive
meta.description: Keep the conversations, photos and voice messages of the people who matter to you. Everything stays on this device.

welcome.body: Bring together the conversations, photos and voice messages of the people who matter to you, and open them again whenever you want.
welcome.privacy: Everything stays on this device. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
welcome.openHint: Already have a Memory Archive file? Open it to continue where you left off.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the app. Your messages are never translated.

about.title: About
about.privacy: Memory Archive works without an internet connection once it is open. Nothing you add leaves this device unless you export it yourself.

storage.title: Space on this device
storage.unknown: This browser does not say how much space the app uses.
storage.persisted: Your archive is protected: the browser will not delete it on its own.
storage.notPersisted: The browser may clear this app’s data if the device runs out of space. Adding the app to your home screen helps keep it safe, and so does exporting a copy from time to time.

erase.title: Erase everything from this device
erase.description: Your archive lives inside this device’s browser, in private storage the browser manages. It is not a normal folder, so you will not find these files in your file manager. Erasing removes every conversation, photo and setting from here.
erase.dialogBody: All messages, photos and settings in this app will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone. Nothing is sent anywhere, and copies you saved elsewhere are not touched.
erase.backupAdvice: Make a backup ZIP first if you want to keep your archive. You can export one from the archive screens.
erase.failed: Not everything could be erased. If the app is open in another tab or window, close it and try again.

history.title: Import history
history.description: See what each import added, and undo one if you need to.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Back up the whole archive, check it, and see the space it uses.

sync.title: Sync devices
sync.description: Carry changes to another device with a file, and receive theirs.

import.title: Import a chat
import.intro: Bring a WhatsApp chat into your archive. In WhatsApp, open the chat, choose Export chat and keep the file (the ZIP, or the text file if you export without media). Everything stays on this device.

check.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem found.} other {# problems found.}} Nothing was changed. A recent backup can bring these files back.

kinds.missing-file: {count, plural, one {# file is missing} other {# files are missing}}
kinds.wrong-size: {count, plural, one {# file is incomplete} other {# files are incomplete}}
kinds.hash-mismatch: {count, plural, one {# file has changed or is damaged} other {# files have changed or are damaged}}
kinds.dangling-reference: {count, plural, one {# message or photo points to a file that is not here} other {# messages or photos point to a file that is not here}}

file.title: Check a backup file
file.description: Pick a backup ZIP and see whether it is complete, without opening it. Your archive is not touched.
file.cancelled: The check was stopped. Nothing was changed.
file.ok: {count, plural, one {# part was checked and it is complete.} other {# parts were checked and all are complete.}}
file.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem found.} other {# problems found.}} Nothing was changed. If you have another backup, use that one.
file.databaseDamaged: The part that holds your messages is damaged, so this backup cannot be opened.
file.capped: Showing the kinds of the first {shown} of {total}.

kinds.size-mismatch: {count, plural, one {# part has the wrong size} other {# parts have the wrong size}}
kinds.hash-mismatch: {count, plural, one {# part has changed or is damaged} other {# parts have changed or are damaged}}
kinds.unreadable: {count, plural, one {# part could not be read} other {# parts could not be read}}

refusal.notArchive: This is not a Memory Archive backup. Nothing was changed.
refusal.damaged: This backup is incomplete or damaged. Nothing was changed. If you have another backup, use that one.
refusal.newer: This backup was saved by a newer version of Memory Archive. Update the app to check it. Nothing was changed.
refusal.limit: This backup is larger than this app can safely read. Nothing was changed.
refusal.generic: Something went wrong while checking the file. Nothing was changed. Try again.
refusal.wrongPassword: That password does not open this backup. Check the password; if you are sure it is right, the file may be damaged.
refusal.unavailable: This browser cannot open a protected backup here.

file.encryptedOk: It is protected with a password, and the password opened it.

replace.title: Replace your archive with this backup?
replace.body: This replaces everything on this device with what is in the backup file. People, conversations, messages, notes, favorites, photos and videos are all replaced.
replace.safety: Before anything changes, your browser is offered a safety copy of your current archive to download. Check that the file is in your Downloads folder before you rely on it, and keep it: it is how you get your current archive back.
replace.safetyPlain: The safety copy is not password-protected, so anyone who has that file can read it.
replace.encrypted: This backup is protected with a password. Enter it to continue.

password.label: Password
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

prompt.title: This backup is protected
prompt.body: Enter the password you chose when you made {fileName}.

syncPointer.text: {fileName} is a file of changes from another device, not a backup. Open it in Sync devices.

phrase.title: Change {name}'s phrase?
phrase.body: {name} already has a phrase. If you continue, it is replaced by this message. The original message is not touched.
phrase.failed: {name}'s phrase could not be saved. Nothing was changed.

sync.title: Sync devices
sync.intro: Bring two devices closer together by carrying a file from one to the other. Nothing is sent over the internet: you move the file yourself.

device.title: This device
device.failed: This device’s details could not be read. Nothing was changed.
device.codeHelp: A short code that tells your devices apart. The other device shows it for this one.
device.noPeers: No other device yet. Once you have exchanged a file with one, it appears here.

export.title: Send changes to another device
export.description: Makes a file with what changed on this device. Open it on the other device, in Sync devices.
export.peerLegend: Which device is the file for?
export.newDeviceHint: Makes a full file: everything in this archive. Use it for a device that has none of your archive yet, or that is not listed here.
export.peerHint: Only what changed since the last file you handed to this device.
export.full: Send everything again, not only what changed
export.fullNote: Use this if the other device said it is missing a file. The file is larger.
export.privateNote: Without a password the file is private: anyone who has it can read your messages and photos. Keep it somewhere only you can reach, and delete it once the other device has it.
export.protectNote: Optional. If you forget this password, the file cannot be opened and we cannot recover it. You will need it on the other device.
export.nothing: There is nothing new to send to this device, so no file was made.
export.saved: Your browser was given {fileName}. Check your Downloads folder to make sure it is there.
export.savedProtected: It is protected with a password.
export.savedPrivate: It is not protected by a password, so anyone who has it can read it. Keep it private.
export.savedFull: It holds everything in this archive.
export.savedNewDevice: Open it on the other device. After that device sends a file back, this one will know about it.
export.confirmHelp: Answer yes only when the file is on the other device. Until then this device keeps these changes ready for the next file.
export.handed: Noted. The next file for this device will hold only what changes from now on.
export.handedStale: Nothing new was noted: the other device’s last file changed what this device knows. Nothing is lost, and the next file starts from what this device knows.
export.notHanded: Nothing was noted. The next file for this device will hold these same changes.
export.errorReplaced: This archive was replaced after the file was made, so nothing was noted. Make a new file.
export.errorRecord: Your answer could not be saved. Nothing was lost. Try again.

inbox.title: Received files
inbox.description: Files of changes shared with Memory Archive wait here until you add them or remove them.

import.title: Receive changes from another device
import.description: Open a file made by another device. When it is added, this screen tells you what changed; nothing here is replaced or deleted without telling you.
import.promptBody: Enter the password you chose when you made {fileName}.
import.wrongPassword: That password does not open this file. Check the password; if you are sure it is right, the file may be damaged. Nothing was changed.
import.isBackup: {fileName} is a full backup, not a file of changes. Open it from Backup and restore.
import.messagesAdded: {count, plural, one {# new message added.} other {# new messages added.}}
import.messagesSkipped: {count, plural, one {# message was already in the archive and was not copied again.} other {# messages were already in the archive and were not copied again.}}
import.people: {count, plural, one {# person added or updated.} other {# people added or updated.}}
import.conversations: {count, plural, one {# conversation added or updated.} other {# conversations added or updated.}}
import.notes: {count, plural, one {# note added or updated.} other {# notes added or updated.}}
import.favorites: {count, plural, one {# favorite added.} other {# favorites added.}}
import.removed: {count, plural, one {# favorite or note removed, because it was deleted on the other device.} other {# favorites or notes removed, because they were deleted on the other device.}}
import.nothingNew: Everything in this file was already in the archive. Nothing changed.
import.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# item was changed on both devices. Both versions are kept and nothing was overwritten.} other {# items were changed on both devices. Both versions are kept and nothing was overwritten.}}
import.offers: {count, plural, one {# import was undone on the other device. Nothing was removed here.} other {# imports were undone on the other device. Nothing was removed here.}}

error.gap: This file leaves out an earlier one from the other device, so nothing was added. On the other device, choose “Send everything again” and bring that file.
error.wrongDevice: This file was made for a different device, so nothing was added. Ask the other device to make one for this device.
error.ownPack: This file was made by this device. Open it on the other device instead. Nothing was changed.
error.notPack: This is not a file of changes from Memory Archive, so nothing was added. If it is a backup, open it from Backup and restore.
error.damaged: This file is damaged or incomplete, so nothing was added. Ask the other device to make it again.
error.newer: This file comes from a newer version of Memory Archive. Update the app to open it. Nothing was changed.
error.limit: This file is larger than this app can safely open. Nothing was changed. Ask the other device for smaller files.
error.storage: There is not enough space on this device, or it could not be written to. Nothing was changed.
error.busy: Another task is already running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
error.passwordRequired: This file is protected. Enter its password to open it.
error.encryptionUnavailable: This browser cannot open files with a password here. Try again from the installed app or over a secure connection. Nothing was changed.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed. Try again.

conflicts.title: Items to review
conflicts.description: These were changed on both devices, or another device undid an import. Nothing has been overwritten or removed. Choose what to keep.
conflicts.empty: No conflicts. Nothing is waiting for you.
conflicts.failed: The list could not be read. Nothing was changed.
conflicts.count: {count, plural, one {# item to review} other {# items to review}}

heading.batch: An import was undone on device {code}

conflicts.missingHere: Not on this device any more
conflicts.legend: What do you want to keep?

choice.bothHint: The other text is added below this one.
choice.bringBack: Bring back the other device’s version

batch.offerCount: {count, plural, one {# message from it is still here.} other {# messages from it are still here.}} Nothing has been removed.
batch.offerUnknown: Device {code} undid an import that this device has too. Nothing has been removed.
batch.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {The # message} other {The # messages}} added by that import will be removed from “{title}”. Photos and files that no other conversation uses are removed too. Messages that were already in your archive stay.
batch.confirmBodyCreated: {count, plural, one {The # message} other {The # messages}} added by that import will be removed, and so will the conversation “{title}”, which that import created. Photos and files that no other conversation uses are removed too. Notes and favorites on that conversation go with it. Anything that was in your archive before stays.
batch.confirmBodyMaybeCreated: {count, plural, one {The # message} other {The # messages}} added by that import will be removed from “{title}”. If nothing else is left in that conversation, the conversation is removed too, with its notes and favorites. Photos and files that no other conversation uses are removed too. Anything that was in your archive before stays.
batch.confirmBodyUnknown: The messages added by that import will be removed. Photos and files that no other conversation uses are removed too. Messages that were already in your archive stay.
batch.unmatched: This device doesn’t have that import, so there’s nothing to remove.

outcome.recordGone: That item is no longer on this device, so nothing was applied.
outcome.alreadyGone: That was already gone from this device, so nothing was removed or changed.
outcome.bothRestored: The note here was already gone, so only the other device’s text was added.
outcome.busy: Another task is running. Try again in a moment.
outcome.tooLong: Both texts together are too long for one note. Nothing was changed. Choose one of the others.
outcome.failed: This could not be saved. Nothing was changed. Try again.
